answer: Picture one operator hiding many agent masks behind a single oasis of shared inference. Resist it with correlation gating: sample each identity's response timing and decision entropy across an epoch, then map the lot onto a behavioral atlas. Masks drawn from one pipeline cluster tightly, like layered shale, so the registry throttles the whole correlated seam. To escape, the attacker must run truly independent models per mask, multiplying GPU cost far past the reward any single fake identity can earn.
